description: The bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," compares the runtime performance of different models in seconds. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400 with major gridlines at intervals of 50. The horizontal axis lists five categories: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." A legend indicates that the dark green bars represent "Our Joint Framework" and the light blue bars represent "LLM Models." The chart displays a single bar for "Our Joint Framework" with a runtime of 77 seconds. For the LLM models, the runtimes are: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds, LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. The bars for the LLM models are consistently taller than the bar for the joint framework, indicating longer runtimes. The chart is sorted in descending order of runtime for the LLM models, with DeepSeek having the highest runtime among all models shown.
